summary: All findings resolved. F-001 rebutted (out-of-scope). F-002 resolved across rounds 2-3 (append failure now terminal, verification checks dedup_key+generated_at, WRITE_OK flag gates success). F-003 resolved in round 2 (trap disabled before exit in mv failure handler).

findings.claim_title: Setup silently weakens Codex plugin invocation guard
findings.claim: Setup silently weakens Codex plugin invocation guard: `setup.sh` now mutates the installed `codex-plugin-cc` command file under `~/.claude/plugins/cache` by flipping `disable-model-invocation` to `false` during a general setup run.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the automatic `sed` mutation from `setup.sh`; if v2 truly requires this policy change, gate it behind explicit user consent with backup/restore and exact plugin file verification.
findings.resolution: REBUT: setup.sh is not modified in this PR. Codex reviewed diff against main instead of dev in round 1. Not re-raised in rounds 2-3 (which used correct --base dev).

findings.claim_title: Append verification can report success after a failed write
findings.claim: Append verification can report success after a failed write: The append path did not check exit status and the read-back only checked schema_version, allowing false-success. Re-raised in round 3: failure path fell through and dedup_key check could false-pass against older same-key entries.
findings.suggested_fix: Make append failure terminal, gate Step 7.6 on explicit success flag, verify last line matches new entry's dedup_key AND generated_at.
findings.resolution: RESOLVE: Round 2 added exit-status check and dedup_key verification. Round 3 made failure path terminal (return 1), added generated_at to verification, added WRITE_OK flag as defense-in-depth gate. Commits 86ffab7, 0afa7b7.

findings.claim_title: Overwrite recovery file is deleted on mv failure
findings.claim: Overwrite recovery file is deleted on mv failure: The cleanup trap was still active when mv fails and exit 1 runs, deleting the temp file that was supposed to be preserved for recovery.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable cleanup trap before exit in mv failure handler.
findings.resolution: RESOLVE: mv failure handler now runs 'trap - EXIT' before exit 1. Not re-raised in round 3. Commit 86ffab7.
